fact: NCRA held a two-day stakeholder validation meeting on 10-11 September 2026 to review its draft 2025 Vital Statistics Report compiled from civil registration, with fertility and mortality data the focus; the report was not yet final.

NCRA's Director General said that, with EU technical assistance, NCRA has established a Directorate of Vital Statistics responsible for monthly and periodic collection, compilation, analysis and production of data from civil registration; no report is named. Date is the document's published date.

The Countdown to 2030 synthesis report, prepared by Statistics Sierra Leone, the Ministry of Health and APHRC, publishes RMNCAH indicators for 2019-2024 computed from routinely reported health facility data in DHIS2 (national reporting completeness 93-99 percent, annual data quality score 71-85); as_of is the report's published year, 2025, its figures cover 2019-2024.
